scenario: Build-unit recipe authoring: a graph rule assembles a command by interpolating per-file bindings into an emit String slot — emit Step argv: "cc -O2 -c -o {s.obj} {s.src}" — and that argv reaches the harness verbatim at dispatch (run logs s.argv). Pins interpolation-assembled recipes.
rules_ds:
schema Src scope logical:
    obj: String key
    src: String key
schema Product scope logical:
    name: String key
    pathname: String mutable
    digest: String mutable
schema Step scope logical:
    id: String key
    argv: String mutable
schema Output scope logical:
    name: String key
    step: String mutable
    pathname: String mutable
schema Consumes scope logical:
    step: String key
    product: String key
schema Blocked scope logical:
    step: String key
schema Ready scope logical:
    step: String key
schema ActionKey scope logical:
    step: String key
    action_key: String mutable
schema Dispatched scope logical:
    step: String key
service cache.key:
    kwarg step: String
    no response
service exec.run:
    kwarg step: String
    kwarg argv: String
    no response
rule graph:
    Src s
->
    emit Step logical id: s.obj argv: "cc -O2 -c -o {s.obj} {s.src}"
    emit Output logical name: s.obj step: s.obj pathname: s.obj
    emit Consumes logical step: s.obj product: s.src
rule block_input:
    Consumes c
    no Product p where p.name == c.product
->
    emit Blocked logical step: c.step
rule ready:
    Step s
    no Blocked b where b.step == s.id
->
    emit Ready logical step: s.id
rule fetch_key:
    Ready r
    no ActionKey k where k.step == r.step
->
    call cache.key step: r.step nocooldown
rule run:
    ActionKey k
    no Dispatched d where d.step == k.step
    Step s where s.id == k.step
->
    call exec.run step: s.id argv: s.argv nocooldown
    log critical "{s.argv}"
